rationale: Deictic 'currently' is read at audit_as_of 2026-07-21. Authoritative DPIC state-by-state evidence reports 27 states with the death penalty and 23 without; WPR likewise treats death penalty as permitted in 27 states. That current count (27) differs from the frozen answer 31. Listed post-reference abolitions (New Hampshire 2019, Colorado 2020, Virginia 2021) establish later downward revisions of the count, so the frozen figure is superseded by revision rather than still valid.
